reports.title: Ball Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: “Our third quarter results reflect disciplined execution across the business, supported by global volume growth, operational performance and the stability provided by our contractual passthrough mechanisms. We remain on track to deliver our long-term objective of 4 to 6 percent operating earnings growth while continuing to generate strong cash flow and grow EVA across the business. Our balanced approach to capital allocation enables us to return significant cash to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends while investing in attractive EVA-accretive growth opportunities. Supported by a strong financial position and disciplined financial framework, we remain focused on improving returns, strengthening earnings power and delivering attractive long-term shareholder returns,” said Dan Rabbitt, senior vice president and chief financial officer.

“Our strategy remains centered on building long-term value through strong customer partnerships, an engaged and empowered workforce, and disciplined operational and capital deployment decisions. The Ball Business System continues to strengthen our culture of ownership and accountability, while EVA remains the financial framework that guides how we invest, improve and grow the business. We see significant opportunities ahead to deploy capital into EVA-accretive growth projects, including investments that support our customers and strengthen our global manufacturing network. While the external environment remains volatile, we are confident in our ability to build on our momentum, invest behind attractive EVA-accretive opportunities and deliver sustainable growth for years to come,” Lewis said.
